entry.title: Do LLMs know when they have enough information to answer?

link.title: Do LLMs know when they have enough information to answer?

entry.content: We spend a lot of time developing LLMs and agents that can answer the questions we ask them. But the reverse direction gets much less attention: when the prompt does not contain enough information, can a model recognize what is missing and ask for it? [New paper] [Project website]

entry.title: An AI agent for therapeutic reasoning across biological contexts

link.title: An AI agent for therapeutic reasoning across biological contexts

entry.content: Medea is an AI agent that nominates therapeutic targets across cell type contexts, predicts synthetic lethality in cancer cell lines, and forecasts immunotherapy response from multimodal patient profiles. To test whether Medea can identify the genetic vulnerabilities that DNA-damaging treatments exploit, we use it to scan 238,046 gene combinations for synthetic lethality. [Project website]
